decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that updates all FAQ entries describing prize collection from automatic transfer to a conditional manual claim flow.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY stating that prize winners use the claim button when the prize is claimable.
The source resolves prize collection behavior, not winner selection, eligibility, ticket weighting, or Chainlink VRF behavior.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing manual collection through a conditionally visible claim button, followed by RESUME.
Changing how a winner collects a prize does not alter mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, or prize-pool funding.
The source concerns collection of a drawn prize and does not change random commission or ticket allocation for no-referral mints.
The manual prize-claim decision does not change ticket issuance, eligibility windows, expiration, reset, or first-mint ticket behavior.
The source does not change how tickets, commissions, referrals, or earnings must be represented in accounting views.

The source does not change the landing-page hero copy, selling-point emphasis, CTA, book-cover placement, or layout.

The prize-collection decision does not change Transak payment methods, fiat conversion, wallet requirements, purchase fulfillment, or the candidate's deferred lifecycle.
